sourceTitle: Transform notes, research, and sources into interactive sites with Gemini Notebook.
originalTitle: Transform notes, research, and sources into interactive sites with Gemini Notebook.
author: Maria Ines Aranguren

blocks.text: Starting today, Gemini Notebook can turn your sources into interactive sites to help you quickly make sense of complex information.
blocks.zh: 从今天起，Gemini Notebook 可以将你的资料来源转化为互动网站，帮助你快速理解复杂信息。
blocks.en: Starting today, Gemini Notebook can turn your sources into interactive sites to help you quickly make sense of complex information.

blocks.text: To get started, simply type “make me a site” in your Gemini Notebook chat along with a description of what you want to build for work or study, such as:
blocks.zh: 要开始使用，只需在 Gemini Notebook 聊天中输入“make me a site”，并描述你想要为工作或学习构建的内容，例如：
blocks.en: To get started, simply type “make me a site” in your Gemini Notebook chat along with a description of what you want to build for work or study, such as:

blocks.text: Visual explainers to help you prepare for exams, like an interactive periodic table or a historical timeline.
blocks.zh: 帮助你备考的可视化讲解内容，例如互动式元素周期表或历史时间轴。
blocks.en: Visual explainers to help you prepare for exams, like an interactive periodic table or a historical timeline.

blocks.text: Interactive dashboards to explore your data, such as quarterly sales performance.
blocks.zh: 用于探索数据的互动仪表板，例如季度销售业绩。
blocks.en: Interactive dashboards to explore your data, such as quarterly sales performance.

blocks.text: Project management trackers to outline your tasks and deadlines.
blocks.zh: 用于罗列任务和截止日期的项目管理跟踪器。
blocks.en: Project management trackers to outline your tasks and deadlines.

blocks.text: Once built, select “Open in a new tab” to interact with it, or share it with others.
blocks.zh: 构建完成后，选择“在新标签页中打开”即可与之互动，或与他人分享。
blocks.en: Once built, select “Open in a new tab” to interact with it, or share it with others.

blocks.text: This capability is rolling out globally on the web today for Gemini Notebook users (18+), including Google Workspace subscribers, and is coming soon to the mobile app.
blocks.zh: 此功能今天起在网页端面向全球 Gemini Notebook 用户（18 岁及以上）逐步推出，包括 Google Workspace 订阅者，并将很快登陆移动应用。
blocks.en: This capability is rolling out globally on the web today for Gemini Notebook users (18+), including Google Workspace subscribers, and is coming soon to the mobile app.
